notes.title: Twinstick Arcade Is OUT Now On Steam!
notes.content:
Blast and dash through in a gorgeous retro 2D world! Explore and fight your way out of the arcade machine. Speedrun through tight combat encounters. Improve your high-scores. And most of all: tolerate the colour green.

 Seven intricate maze-like levels to explore!
 Dozens of unique combat encounters!
 Take on challenging enemies as you fight your way out!

Endless mode throws wave after wave at you to see how long you can last. Play hard! Escape from the arcade machine! For a limited time, you can get 15% off Twinstick Arcade on Steam. Hope you all enjoy!
